items.claim: Two distinct graphs are proposed. A capability graph answers what the organisation can do, who owns the competence, what is required, which models work, who may verify, which capabilities depend on others and which surfaces may be affected. A work graph answers what is happening right now: intent, task, worker, attempt, candidate, verification, outcome. The capability graph materialises the work graph per intent, and the Digital Twin shows both - the point being that headcount-style org tools mostly have the first and the bootstrap mostly builds the second, and Nortropic can join them. Companion to RND-075's capability-as-primitive, which does not itself carry the two-graph split.

items.claim: A why/assumption graph is proposed where every dependency edge carries its why, its assumption and its evidence, so an invalidated assumption is traversed to its descendants: affected artifacts go STALE and only that subtree is reverified, not everything. A later turn makes it an Epistemic Edge Contract (epistemic_type SOURCE_EXPLICIT/DETERMINISTIC_DERIVED/MODEL_INFERRED/OWNER_DECIDED/EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY/PRODUCTION_OBSERVED/EXPERIMENT_ESTABLISHED, plus evidence, confidence, valid_from, last_verified, invalidation_trigger) so a git-proven and a model-guessed edge never carry the same status, and runs the chain invalid assumption -> stale decision -> capability eligible for ablation. A third gives its executable form, Incremental Organizational Recompute: a changed design token recomputes only affected components, pages, render and visual/a11y verification, not customer research, content or unrelated work - the stated payoff being dramatically faster future loops with no quality loss.

items.claim: Not every small variation is a deviation. The entry criterion for the deviation pipeline requires target, tolerance or control range, trend, confidence and context, so that a lead time of 23h inside a 14-22h normal range is normal variation and raises nothing; reacting to every fluctuation makes the control itself counterproductive. The same criterion supplies the proactive class: a sustained trend (28h -> 31h -> 35h -> 39h) raises an emerging performance deviation before the hard limit has been crossed. Without both ends the deviation primitive the corpus does carry misbehaves in both directions — noisy at one end, late at the other.

items.claim: A rise in registered deviations does not mean the organisation has become worse; it can mean it has become a better sensing organisation, which is what an external municipal quality report itself concluded about its own increase. items.claim: Aquarium's encoding contract assigns one meaning per visual channel: geometry = the relatively stable organizational structure (changes rarely); objects = work, artefacts, queues, resources (must match true state); movement = state transitions and handoffs (must have canonical evidence); occupancy = active execution/capability (real activity only); lighting/atmosphere = health, attention, operational condition (derived through explicit semantics); ambient life = beauty only, and may never assert operational state. Decorative ambience (coffee, lamps, weather, plants, idle movement) is explicitly permitted and must not be deleted, but must be visually separable from state-bearing animation. The separation is kinematic, not stylistic: ambient motion is local, looping, low-salience, non-directional; work motion is directional, non-looping, boundary-crossing, event-driven, so anything that travels across the world is learned to mean something happened.

items.claim: Aquarium's value hypothesis is diagnostic, not decorative. City Hall should almost always be boring: an ordinary day shows activity in the departments and nearly nothing at City Hall, which makes City Hall traffic a visual KPI for autonomy. If everything suddenly converges there, the spatial picture alone says the organization is over-centralized without consulting any management metric. The stronger, falsifiable form: after months of ambient watching a person should get intuitions ('this looks unusually hectic', 'verification is not draining as usual', 'why is so much going to City Hall') that later prove out against measured contention, lead time, or an authority design creating unnecessary approvals. That is a visual intuition for an organization with no physical body, as a factory manager senses trouble before the report arrives.

items.claim: Four things must be separated and versioned independently: organizational semantics ('what is true'), projection semantics ('what Aquarium chooses to expose'), visual grammar ('how that meaning is encoded') and art direction ('what it looks and feels like'). items.claim: The canonical event record must carry more than chronology if replay and lineage are to stay truthful. (b) Explicit causal relations (derived_from, evaluated, caused_by, supersedes) after W3C provenance and OpenLineage's explicit flow edges, since consecutive events need not be causally linked; this is what gives every visual object a proof path down to evidence. items.claim: Prompt structure as cache discipline: build every Nortropic prompt as a STABLE PREFIX (role instructions, constitutional map, tool definitions, output schema) followed by a VARIABLE SUFFIX (task capsule, candidate SHA, latest findings), rather than regenerating a large prompt in a different order each attempt. This is the thread's answer to what 'compression' may mean without cost — lossless compression through reuse, i.e. reuse of the invariant part, not removal of information — and it names which half is allowed to vary. It rests on the observed practice that the previous prompt is made an exact prefix of the next request, and that changing the tool list, model or sandbox early in the prompt destroys the cache hit.

items.uncertainty: low that the practice is reported as external fact and that the prefix/suffix split is the assistant's application of it; unverified for Nortropic — no measurement of cache behaviour on its own prompts exists in the source, and the owner never replied. Cache mechanics are provider-specific and can change.

items.claim: The two coding executors do not receive the same repository authority. Claude Code does not read AGENTS.md directly — Anthropic's documentation says it reads CLAUDE.md, and a repo already using AGENTS.md should have CLAUDE.md import it (@AGENTS.md) and add only Claude-specific instructions underneath — while Codex reads AGENTS.md automatically at session start. items.claim: 'Feeding an AI books' is disambiguated into five different things: pretraining or continued pretraining, which bakes knowledge into the model's weights; fine-tuning, which changes behaviour, style or ability; retrieval, where the material stays outside the model and relevant passages are fetched when needed; memory, where the system stores what happened and reuses it; and continual learning, where the system improves over time from new experience. The distinction settles what 'Nortropic learns continuously' means in this corpus: the learning lives in the system — knowledge, experience, retrieval, memory — and deliberately not in the model's weights, precisely so the base model (Codex, Claude, GPT) stays interchangeable. The model does not memorise the book; it gets the right five pages when they are needed.

items.claim: The transferable philosophy from Functional Programming in Scala — the philosophy, not the Scala language — is to represent the system's rules so incorrect states become hard or impossible to express. Concretely: model the lifecycle as real distinct types, not strings and conditionals — PlannedTask → AuthorizedTask → RunningTask → Candidate → ReviewedCandidate → OwnerApprovedCandidate → PromotableCandidate → IntegratedTask — so merge(Candidate) does not merely fail at runtime but is not even accepted; merge requires OwnerApprovedCandidate, making the owner gate structural rather than procedural. Alongside it a functional core with an imperative shell for the controller: state plus event go through a pure transition yielding new state plus requested effects, running no shell, writing no files, pushing nothing, calling no API, while a separate effect executor does git commits, gate runs, agent starts and PRs — making replay, simulation and property testing far easier.

items.claim: Definition of the term the corpus uses as if defined: a Gauntlet loop - named by Matt Shumer in late July 2026, not an Anthropic term though close to Anthropic's own generator-evaluator harnesses - is to let an agent build, let a separate and hard agent judge the actual result against a concrete quality bar, and keep iterating until the result clears the bar. Its core is split -> build -> judge -> repeat, with each critic running in fresh context and looking at the real artifact rather than at the builder's account of it. The cycle closes back on the 'biggest remaining gap': on LOSE the critic returns the largest remaining quality gap and the builder fixes that one, so the retry is gap-prioritised rather than an undirected rebuild. What Gauntlet adds over a plain persistence loop (Ralph, a bash while-loop restarting the agent) is resistance: a separate critic and a concrete external bar.
items.scope: assurance-red-team / definition of the Gauntlet loop

items.claim: The Gauntlet method's own evidence bounds where it pays. Shumer's README now says the flagship Claude-of-Duty run did not reach its goal: eleven adversarial critics moved it roughly 3.59 → 4.14 → 4.05 → 5.05 out of 10 — non-monotonically, about one and a half points for eleven rounds — and in blind A/B everyone still chose the real game. Parallel fan-out worked badly on coupled systems: three rounds with six agents owning separate directories gave only small improvement and eventually increased visual defects, because tonemapping, sky and indirect lighting were really one coupled system; a sequential pass with one owner per coupled problem did considerably better. And Anthropic's long-running harness found evaluator lift concentrates near the edge of the generator's current capability, becoming mostly overhead for work the generator already handles reliably — so assurance ceremony on routine change is pure cost.

items.claim: Fresh context for the critic is an epistemic boundary, not a security boundary. Its purpose is defence against the builder's own sunk-cost defence, rationalisation, anchoring on the builder's diagnosis, continuation bias and 'I know why I did it this way' — the critic is handed the artifact and the contract and told to try to break it, rather than being asked to review its own reasoning. The classification is already frozen in the project's own settings, which are to be kept verbatim: CODEX_ROLE_SEPARATION=WORKFLOW and CODEX_ROLE_SEPARATION_IS_SECURITY_BOUNDARY=NO. Treating the context boundary as if it contained an adversary would both over-build it and over-trust it.

items.claim: Verifiability belongs in the builder's objective, not only correctness. Drawing on OpenAI's prover–verifier result — strong models optimised purely for the right answer can produce results that are harder for others to verify, so the training also optimises checkability/legibility — the proposed Nortropic rule is that a builder should not merely be rewarded for correct code but should produce a candidate that is cheap to falsify and verify. A good candidate is not a clever one: correct, simple enough to reason about, with clear invariant structure, reproducible evidence, a small enough diff, observable failure modes and easy independent verification. Without it, the cost of independent assurance stays wherever the builder happened to leave it.
items.quote: Buildern bör inte bara belönas för att producera korrekt kod. Den bör producera en kandidat som är lätt att falsifiera och verifiera.
items.uncertainty: medium — assistant formulation derived from cited external research; no owner reaction and nothing built

items.claim: The owner relayed a two-part critique of the Gauntlet loop that triggered the revised verification chain. First: the main agent is completely responsible for checking — it spins up the critics, writes their instructions and passes the judgement prompt, so the agent figures everything out by itself and, at the scale it works at, you will not be able to work out what caused an issue in the long run; checking should be set concretely rather than left to the agent. Second, and decisive for whether the method applies at all: the quality bar in the example was an existing product, so the critic had something real to measure against. When you build something new there is nothing to set the bar by, the critic invents a standard and passes work against it — and having nothing to compare the work to is the normal case, not the exception.
items.scope: assurance-red-team / the two conditions the Gauntlet method depends on
items.quote: having nothing to compare the work to is the normal case, not the exception

items.claim: When critics, criteria, prompts and observations are generated dynamically inside the lead agent's context there is no stable explanation of what happened, and four distinct failure classes become indistinguishable: PRODUCT FAILURE, EVALUATOR FAILURE, ORCHESTRATION FAILURE and SPECIFICATION FAILURE. Facing a bad outcome you cannot tell a bad product from a bad evaluator, bad orchestration or a bad specification, and you cannot tell whether the definition of 'good' drifted between rounds. That is the stated reason checks must be separate, durable first-class objects rather than the agent's spontaneous thoughts — attribution, not ceremony, is what the structure buys.
items.scope: assurance-red-team / failure attribution in agentic quality loops

items.claim: Two capture tiers with different fidelity claims are proposed for archiving chats. The vendor's official Data Export is the most canonical raw source - a ZIP with conversations.json (or several numbered conversation JSON files) - from which full-chat.md can be built out of exported conversation data rather than out of the model's own memory. Its disadvantage is that a full data export can take up to seven days, which makes it useless for a 'this chat was good, save it now' workflow. The proposal is therefore a shared link for immediate capture and a periodic data export for backup and maximal canonical fidelity. The tiers carry an honesty obligation, not just different fidelity: a fast capture saved from the current context must be labelled honestly as 'context-capture', never as a guaranteed canonical transcript. No documented official API exists for pulling an arbitrary consumer ChatGPT conversation by id; the documentation points to shared links or data export.

items.claim: A chat capture can be silently truncated and silently vendor-coupled. ChatGPT uses virtualised rendering on long conversations, so a naive DOM script — a bookmarklet, for instance — risks capturing only the turns currently mounted and returning a transcript that looks complete; the open-source extension handles this by scrolling and loading the whole conversation before export, which is the stated reason to start with an extension rather than a bookmarklet. Separately, a dependency on an undocumented internal ChatGPT API must not become the core contract, since the vendor can change the web app at any time. The strategy is PRIMARY rendered conversation and browser state, an OPTIONAL FAST PATH over structured internal data, and VERIFY on message count, first and last message and non-empty turns, falling back to DOM capture when the fast path fails.

items.claim: The method must not become an ordinary AI readiness assessment, and elimination is a first-class outcome. The required order is: first understand the work actually performed; then question whether the work should exist in its present form at all; and only then decide what is eliminated, done by an agent, done by a human, or placed behind an authority boundary. Automating the old process is explicitly not the goal — after the current state is understood, the function is redesigned zero-based against ten questions: what outcome, what state, what events, what must be decided, what can disappear entirely, what can run asynchronously, what can be parallel, what can be verified mechanically, what human judgment remains, and what authority can be delegated. items.claim: Three representational tests decide whether a function has actually been understood. items.claim: A two-step capital path is proposed instead of the classic incubator → pitch deck → pre-seed → seed → VC ladder. Phase 1: financed by Nortropic itself and customer revenue, possibly loans, grants or project funds and the Arctic Business ecosystem, to prove revenue, workflow, outcomes, capabilities and product thesis. Phase 2: venture or regional capital only once the work can be shown no longer to be consulting — 'Här är maskinen. Här är kunderna. Här är retention. Här är unit economics.' The sequencing is argued from Almi's own stated criteria: venture capital generally does not suit consultancy and person-dependent service businesses and fits better when the model scales without a matching cost increase, while Almi seeks scalable products with international potential and an active team. Msg 12 adds Norrlandsfonden as complementary expansion financing and Partnerinvest Norr as regional venture capital for scalable companies with international potential.
items.quote: Almi beskriver uttryckligen riskkapital som dåligt lämpat för tjänsteintensiva och personberoende affärsmodeller och lämpligare när affärsmodellen kan skalas utan motsvarande kostnadsökning.
items.uncertainty: medium — assistant-proposed financing sequence argued from a cited lender's public criteria; no financing decision, application or conversation is recorded anywhere in this source

evidence_refs.name: Almi's stated criteria: venture capital generally unsuited to consultancy and person-dependent businesses; seeks scalable products with international potential and an active team

items.claim: Geographic origin proposed as a moat rather than something to hide: 'Nortropic — built in the Arctic' as an identity grounded in arctic engineering attributes — harsh environment, industrial reality, limited resources, high reliability, energy, infrastructure, resilience, pragmatism, no bullshit — expressed as 'Autonomous organizations built where reliability matters.' Explicitly not tourist branding and explicitly not Silicon Valley cosplay from Luleå. The same turn attaches a credibility condition: the Arctic label becomes trustworthy rather than cosmetic only once the export path actually runs from Norrbotten industrial SMEs through northern Sweden, the Nordics, DACH/Benelux, Europe and the US industrial middle market. The local precedent offered is Arctic Business alumni built in Luleå and sold internationally (Netrounds→Juniper, D-Flow→Badger Meter, BehavioSec).
items.quote: Autonomous organizations built where reliability matters.
items.uncertainty: high — assistant-authored identity proposal; not owner-authored, never tested on a customer, and the exit precedents are analogies rather than evidence about Nortropic

items.claim: External regional research is used as a reality check on the pivot space. IUC Norr's material shows the region's own 2036 scenarios revolving around competence shortage, infrastructure and preparedness, and demands for verifiable data; the underlying survey covers about 200 industrial and industry-near SMEs in Norrbotten and Västerbotten, where three of four want to grow, competence is the largest constraint, and the report recommends floor-level digitalisation of business-critical workflows such as work orders and inventory to cut administration. A later section adds that 52 % have no identified risk or crisis plans. The inference drawn is that several of Nortropic's possible pivots are not fantasies in search of problems but lie close to problems those companies already describe today, and that Industrial Operations should be upgraded from an interesting future idea to one of the most important hypotheses to test actively once Digitala reaches real companies.
items.quote: Det gör att flera av Nortropics möjliga pivots inte är fantasier på jakt efter problem; de ligger nära problem som 200 industrinära SMF redan beskriver idag.
items.uncertainty: medium — the survey findings are cited external research, but the step from 'these companies describe these problems' to 'they would buy autonomous operations from Nortropic' is the assistant's inference and untested

evidence_refs.name: IUC Norr survey of ~200 industrial and industry-near SMEs in Norrbotten and Västerbotten, and its regional 2036 scenarios (competence shortage, infrastructure/preparedness, verifiable-data requirements)

items.claim: Scenario 5, Nortropic Gov: autonomous public-administration förvaltning: digital information management, web accessibility, citizen information, regulation monitoring, case preparation, document quality, internal knowledge, procurement support, service triage, administrative processes. Fit: public bodies need what Nortropic over-invests in: auditability, authority, provenance, explainability, accessibility, change control, evidence, human judgment, clear escalation. Also Sweden's Feb 2026 AI strategy (top-ten AI nation; public administration world's best at using AI; national AI workshop 2026 to full operation 2030) and the region's public-sector competence need. A sequencing verdict: high strategic fit, poor first wedge: procurement, law, security, pilots, reference groups, budget cycles, long implementation can kill an early startup's tempo ('18 månaders försäljning × 5 pilotprojekt × 0 deployment'). GovTech is an excellent second/third market once Nortropic works commercially.
items.quote: hög strategisk fit, dålig first wedge.
items.uncertainty: medium — assistant-constructed scenario with cited policy evidence and its own timing verdict; no public buyer, procurement or pilot exists anywhere in this source. The fit half rests on a general distinction stated in the same turn and not repeated in this claim: a more laissez-faire agent architecture can work for marketing and works considerably worse where public power or personal data is involved ('Den fungerar betydligt sämre när offentlig makt eller persondata är involverad.'). That is why the strictness Nortropic over-invests in pays commercially in this market and not in every market - a rebuild reading the sequencing verdict alone would take the deferral as a judgement on the sector rather than on the sales cycle. Carried in full by RND-469 and RND-488.

evidence_refs.name: Sweden's national AI strategy of February 2026: top-ten AI nation ambition and the goal that Swedish public administration become the world's best at using AI

items.claim: A design distinction stated inside the GovTech scenario but general in force: a more laissez-faire agent architecture can work for marketing, and works considerably worse when public power or personal data is involved. That is given as the reason public bodies need auditability, authority, provenance, explainability, accessibility, change control, evidence, human judgment, clear escalation - strictness is claimed to scale with the stakes of the domain, not the sophistication of the builder. It is the source's only explicit statement of a condition under which Nortropic's apparatus stops being over-engineering and becomes the minimum. The same turn adds the market axis: public administration is the strongest structural fit for the model, yet the verdict is 'hög strategisk fit, dålig first wedge' - procurement, law, security, pilots, reference groups, budget cycles, long implementation can kill an early startup's tempo - GovTech is an excellent second or third market, not a first wedge.

items.claim: Scenario 6 inverts the business model: instead of selling Nortropic to companies, buy the company and install Nortropic — acquire a sound local industrial or service business whose owner wants to leave, with low digitalisation, high administration and mediocre margin, then install Digital, Sales Ops, Administration, Purchasing, Knowledge, Customer Operations and management information, so the productivity and margin gain is owned as equity rather than shared with a customer through a subscription. The result sits between a holding company, private equity, permanent capital, an operator and a software company, measured by EBIT, cash flow, ROIC and working capital rather than SaaS ARR. Two explicit brakes: no evidence yet of a ready roll-up opportunity, only that generational-succession financing exists; and a bad acquisition cannot be rolled back the way a software fault can.

items.claim: Scenario 8, Company Foundry: once Nortropic can understand a market, discover unmet need, design, build, operate, sell, support, measure and learn, it could create its own companies rather than only serving customers' — a company compiler. It is presented as following logically from the internal level ladder, Level 1 do the work → Level 2 improve the capability → Level 3 improve the organization → Level 4 instantiate another organization. Explicitly the science-fiction part of the vision today and not something implementation is planned for, with the option deliberately not discarded. The stated hard part is that it automates entrepreneurial judgment, which the cited Sequoia distinction places on the far side of what models become quickly good at; 2026 venture-studio experiments with small human cores are noted as showing the organizational idea exists, not that it scales.

items.claim: The preferred structure is a sequence rather than a single end scenario, justified by an option asymmetry: Digitala has low downside and can be a profitable company even if Organization OS never happens; Industrial Ops has a considerably larger TAM with Norrbotten as an unusually good wedge; Assurance may be the unexpected technical jackpot where the Kernel turns out to hold the most valuable product; Organization OS keeps maximum upside without being forced before the market asks for it; Holdco and Company Foundry stay as extreme long-term options. The governing principle is optionality as an architecture principle — keeping five options costs far less than choosing the wrong megavision today — with Digitala cast as Nortropic's market sensor, and the stated aim of the next 12–18 months being to tell scenarios 1–4 apart with real evidence rather than to pick one.

Eight very different lives: why the end destination matters even where the technology initially coincides.

items.claim: This source does not settle Nortropic's build order; it states two incompatible ones and never reconciles them. Msg 5: the existing build track — Digitala first, then a finished Autonomy Kernel, then Organization OS and last the control room — is 'fortfarande logiskt'. Msg 12's prose keeps that order ('Jag skulle inte ändra den nuvarande byggordningen'; Digitala first, 'Bootstrapen ska sedan ge oss Autonomy Kernel v1') while the diagram immediately beneath it runs NORTROPIC IDAG → AUTONOMY KERNEL → NORTROPIC DIGITAL. Msg 16 repeats the same internal split: prose 'professionell Digitala-förmåga först, Autonomy Kernel' against its September-2026 play FULL AUTONOMY KERNEL → IMPROVEMENTS RECOMPILE → DIGITALA WORLD-CLASS. Msg 18, the turn carrying the plan the owner assented to, restates Kernel → Recompile → Digitala. Nothing here retracts msg 5's or msg 12's prose, so the order is contested within this source, not decided by it.
items.quote: Det befintliga byggspåret — Digitala först, därefter färdig Autonomy Kernel, sedan Organization OS och till sist kontrollrummet — är därför fortfarande logiskt.
items.uncertainty: explicit — the contradiction is on the page; what is unknown is which order is intended. The owner's assent (msg 17) lands on the msg-16/18 Kernel-first wording, which is why RND-130 records that sequence, but this source states the opposite order twice in prose and its own msg-12 and msg-16 diagrams disagree with their surrounding text.

items.claim: The data model that makes the process-mining proposal concrete, split out of RND-329 for length. Object-centric process mining starts from event logs where a happening can relate to several different kinds of real object at once: OCEL 2.0 models events, objects, activities, relations and changing object attributes instead of forcing the whole world into a single simple 'case' sequence. It is called almost uncannily fitting for Nortropic, because one event can touch TASK, WORKER, ATTEMPT, CANDIDATE, VERIFICATION, CAPABILITY, DEPARTMENT, SERVICE and POLICY simultaneously - so Nortropic could eventually discover the real organizational flow from its own canonical history: not 'this is how we think the process works' but 'this is how Nortropic actually works'.
items.quote: OCEL 2.0 modellerar exempelvis events, objects, activities, relationer och föränderliga object-attribut — i stället för att tvinga hela världen till en enda enkel "case"-sekvens.
items.uncertainty: medium; the OCEL description is the assistant's reading of a cited external standard, never tried against Nortropic's own log, and msg 14 (the last owner turn) does not answer it

After the assistant had presented its layer model, the owner asked in one line whether any layer was missing. items.claim: Salesforce's Winter '27 (31 August) both strengthens and weakens the Organization OS thesis, and the halves must be kept apart. It strengthens the behaviour Nortropic predicted - enterprise systems become capabilities that autonomous workers can use under permissions - because Salesforce now makes enterprise capabilities and governed data available to external agents via API/MCP rather than requiring all intelligence to live inside Salesforce, while its own agents drive whole workflows end-to-end (pipeline qualification, service cases, appointment booking, underwriting). It weakens the product thesis that Nortropic should build a generic integration/agent layer for CRM, data, workflows and permissions: Salesforce will do Salesforce, Microsoft will do Microsoft, OpenAI will do its own. Hence the drawn consequence - Nortropic should orchestrate and verify capabilities from those platforms rather than try to replace them.
items.scope: strategy / build-buy boundary and the confirmed behavioural thesis

items.claim: Nortropic Project Operations, split out of RND-430, is a mandate not a tool: keep the project's administrative reality correct and under control. A large industrial, construction or infrastructure project holds contracts, drawings, specifications, RFIs, meetings, emails, change orders/ÄTA, supplier documents, schedules, inspections, quality records, HSE documentation, permits, approvals, invoices, delivery dates, action lists, deviations, technical questions, progress reports and closeout documentation. The system would read incoming documents and communication; hold authoritative project state; identify missing documents; detect contradictions; track decisions; watch deadlines; create RFIs; follow up suppliers; detect potential ÄTA/change events; compile underlag; control versions; monitor contract requirements; prepare meetings; produce weekly reporting; check that actions are closed; build the closeout documentation; escalate risks. Far more than 'chat with your project documents'.

items.claim: Maintenance Planning Department, split out of RND-430: a mandate, not a predictive-maintenance dashboard - 'we are responsible for the right maintenance happening on the right machine at the right time'. Chain: sensor alert, history, manuals, past faults, diagnosis, risk assessment, maintenance action, spare part, technician availability, work order, execution, verification, knowledge updated. Rotomate (EUR 2.1M for AI turning machine data into maintenance recommendations, SSAB a customer) is the precedent; the next evolution: recommendation to maintenance operation. Six authority and verification questions separate the two and are the conversation's clearest commercial statement of why the architecture matters: to act not advise, the system must know what it may do, how certain it is, what data the decision rested on, who must be involved, whether the action was really carried out, whether the result was correct - much closer to Nortropic's core than ordinary generative AI.
items.scope: strategy / maintenance operations and the recommendation-to-operation boundary
items.quote: **“Vi ansvarar för att rätt underhåll sker på rätt maskin vid rätt tidpunkt.”**
items.uncertainty: high - assistant-authored candidate in msg 5 with an external precedent but no owner response; the six authority/verification questions are asserted, never tested

items.claim: Compliance Department, split out of RND-430, almost tailor-made for Autonomy Kernel plus verification. The customer says 'keep us compliant'; Nortropic runs continuously: regulation monitoring, policy mapping, control mapping, evidence collection, control testing, vendor checks, risk register, gap detection, remediation tracking, training evidence, incident records, audit packages, management reporting. Explicitly not an annual consulting exercise: Continuous Compliance Operations. Market validation is named: Sweden's new cybersecurity law of 15 January 2026 with sharpened risk-management, incident-reporting and management requirements, and Stockholm's Hybridity raising 22 MSEK in February for an AI compliance platform covering NIS2, DORA, GDPR and CSRD. The differentiation is load-bearing: Hybridity mainly sells a system, the hypothesis here is 'we run your compliance function', later 'we also verify your AI agents' - where Digital Department, Assurance and Critical Operations meet.
items.quote: **Continuous Compliance Operations.**
items.uncertainty: high - assistant-authored candidate in msg 5; the external market facts are its own citations and the owner chose none of the twelve candidates

items.claim: Procurement / Supplier Operations, split out of RND-430 and judged more interesting than BidOps in the long run: make sure the company gets the right things from the right suppliers on the right terms and that nothing falls between the stools. The system searches suppliers, sends RFQs, compares quotes, checks requirements, chases documentation, onboards suppliers, watches certificates, follows deliveries, handles contract renewals, spots price deviations, finds alternative suppliers, keeps vendor risk current and prepares purchasing decisions. Two grounds are given for the ranking: this is where Industrial Ops, Assurance and Organization OS converge, and supply-chain risk grows steadily more important under NIS2-like requirements - the regulatory driver behind the judgment.

items.claim: GovTech as an administrative function rather than 'AI for the public sector', split out of RND-430/RND-431: not a Nortropic GovTech chatbot but Autonomous Municipal Administration. The system handles incoming cases, supplements, information gathering, compilations, draft decisions, citizen communication, records (diarie) preparation, documentation, deadlines, reports and meeting material. Where the law or judgement requires it, the human keeps the decision itself - the sharpest statement in this conversation of where autonomy must stop. That is called considerably more transformative than a chatbot. Luleå kommun is the indicator: it writes itself that digitalisation and AI are needed to automate and simplify processes so work tasks can be removed and staff time freed, works during 2026 with SVEA on benefits handling, plain language and decision/service drafting, and lists an HR AI platform, careers-guidance AI and a GRC system among planned IT procurements.

items.claim: The five deprioritised areas with their stated grounds, split out of RND-431. Generic AI customer support: a gigantic market, but brutal competition and little unique Nortropic moat. Generic sales agents: the same, extremely crowded. Copywriting/content agency: will be commoditised very hard, and can be a capability inside Digitala, not Nortropic - a boundary between two entities the corpus otherwise keeps distinct. Generic 'AI consultants': absolutely not an end destination, which deprioritises consulting as a destination rather than as a route. Generic Organization OS: too early and too abstract, with the market already filling with broad self-driving-enterprise positioning (Codento/Google Cloud now marketing Self-Driving Enterprise in the Nordics); the OS should instead be built inductively from real functions rather than invented abstractly.

items.claim: The first coarse Function Intake profile, run on Digitala as the calibration function, has thirteen dimensions and is an intake profile rather than a risk score. Mandate: own digital presence outcome. State: sites, content, brand, SEO, performance, analytics, accessibility etc. Demand: business changes, anomalies, requests, launches, incidents. Actions: design, build, publish, fix, optimize, communicate. Verification: tests, screenshots, analytics, quality gates, runtime checks. Authority: very broad at Customer Zero. Reversibility: generally high. Human core: intent, taste at edge cases, major brand/strategic choices. Regulatory: generally manageable. Physicality: near zero. Digital observability: extremely high. FunctionEval potential: extremely high. Customer Zero suitability: exceptional. It is called almost a perfect lab function - which is why it is the calibration site rather than a candidate being judged on its merits.

items.claim: Why the corpus's strictness pays commercially in some markets and not others, drawn from the Nortropic Gov scenario: the public sector needs a great deal of what Nortropic already over-invests in - auditability, authority, provenance, explainability, accessibility, change control, evidence, human judgment and clear escalation. coverage.note: Densest lens in the corpus: argued across twenty of the thirty bound sources and tested on the real host and on Intake's own corpus; three owner decisions (source-trust boundary, verified-save-only, the H-032 'absence from main is not never-built' correction) and a recurring 'no second truth' law. The corpus's own rule that recurrence across these conversations is shared prior context, not independent corroboration, is carried here and qualifies every convergence claim in this compile. Residual: role truth is inherited from capture; claim fidelity of any derived layer stays judgement.

Owner-decided on ambition (world-class, textbook + radical, non-slop, full steps) and heavily argued for the web förvaltning; the Foundation repair chain is tested in reality. What is missing: no world-class definition has been falsified, the competence register said VALIDATING with about one datapoint, and 'Webbförvaltningen complete' is undefined.

The kommun metaphor, 'Tillsammans är vi Nortropic', Nortropic ≠ Digitala and the workstream split are owner-decided; Organization OS is extensively argued but nothing of it is built, its master prompt lineage is unratified, naming drifts, Owner vs Managing Director is open, and the one method the owner named himself (Scrum) was declined by the assistant rather than decided.

Direction is owner-decided many times over (autonomy as principle, attention over stops, 90/10), but the corpus itself names Executive Function — who decides what work exists — the largest unexplored gap; the attention mechanisms are assistant proposals which the owner repeatedly commissioned as prompts — including the very prompt that delivered the hard-stop taxonomy — and adopted en bloc without wording any boundary himself, and merge authority in practice is unstated. Research-shaped, not build-shaped.

Session continuity and provider handoff are tested in reality (real losses, real recoveries, reload-not-remember written after a loss) — including one recovery the owner authorized that explicitly did not restore the original bytes; 'operate forever' as degraded states, SLOs, continuity tiers and recovery drills exists only as assistant proposals; fresh-session recovery is proven synthetically, not on a real item.

The corpus says it plainly: no real production economics exist, so no cost caps yet — instrument first; identity, authority leases, tenant isolation and the memory firewall are argued but not built; the two compliance alarms were verified against primary sources while the replacement channels they imply were not. What is missing is contact with measured reality, not more argument.

Direction owner-decided (cannot stand still, yrkeserfarenhet, practice bank, co-evolution) and the loop shape recurs in twenty-two instantiations across seven conversations of one project (shared prior context, not independent corroboration); the only learning loop that actually ran is Intake's own proving-run discipline. Web Gym, harness ablation, PROVEN_FOR revalidation and the Evolution Engine are unbuilt designs.

The most owner-decided lens: a dozen explicit owner decisions and four review-queue entries the owner answered by submitting assistant-authored wording; the tool lineage v1 → v4 was built, frozen, broken by reality and re-frozen, and this compile is the lens's own dogfood. Still open: 'rensa', attachments, Sources tab, the Recompile mission spec, and Function Intake's future.

Adversarial review is practised, not just argued: cross-provider review caught real defects, independent gate adjudication ran, measurement was falsified repeatedly, proving runs broke the tooling on purpose. The 'too much' attacker (bureaucracy falsifier), held-out evals and the proposed negative-control canaries remain unrun.

Strong owner signals in own words (Lovable ambition, 'som mat', 'i det enkla bor det vackra', overwhelming Verkstadsgolvet, weeks of relaying) and a qualitative construct set (time to magic, stuckness, bypass pressure); the one operator surface that exists was evaluated only as the owner's own overwhelm verdict on it; none of the surfaces this lens proposes — the cockpit rebuild, the Operator Portal, the Aquarium — was built, and nothing is measured. Kept qualitative by design — no score.

Nortropic does build Nortropic (bootstrap on the real host, Intake on its own corpus, Foundation repair), 'Nortropic as Customer #1' is owner-decided and a Reality Layer — real users, real organisations, real production outcomes over simulation — is an owner-adopted first-class requirement — but the decisive reality contacts (first real autonomous launch, first full customer run, Customer Zero loop, the service-trap test) have not happened; the corpus's own audit calls Nortropic strategically fail-open.

The corpus makes many unknowns explicit (residual-risk registers, NEEDS_EVIDENCE classes, owner deferrals via RQ-023/025/026 and the freeze policy), but no consolidated register existed before this compile and several material unknowns are implicit silences (merge authority, whether prompts were sent, first-run outcome). Deferrals that are owner acts are recorded as such; the rest is UNKNOWN, never implicitly rejected.

unlensed.distinction: Where organisational speed comes from — removing the organisation's surrounding work (environment setup, permission discovery, standard hunting, cleanup of a previous attempt) rather than faster models or larger contexts. This is the worker-side analogue of the corpus's 'experienced complexity must stay flat', which the twelve lenses name only for the human; none of the twelve carries a claim about the source of organisational throughput.

Reasoning-effort and model routing as an assurance budget: how much depth a trust-critical lane is bought, and the claim that breadth of genuinely independent falsification beats depth of single-agent reasoning. It is neither a truth-trust rule about what counts as evidence nor an assurance-red-team method - it is a resourcing decision about the falsifiers themselves, which none of the twelve lenses covers.

External prior art and competitive differentiation - what a commercial product has already shipped of the same idea, and where the corpus's version actually differs. None of the twelve lenses covers reading the outside market against your own originality claim; rnd-intake is about taking ideas in, assurance-red-team about attacking your own work.

Verification is not one thing: the four eval layers (Trust/Policy, Regression, Capability/Quality, Product outcome) each answer a different question and straddle four lenses at once - the gate is truth-trust, regression is assurance-red-team, capability hillclimbing is professional-excellence, product outcome is reality-dogfood - so the distinction itself belongs to none of the twelve singly.

Commercial form - what Nortropic sells, owns or underwrites (operating company/roll-up, franchise, venture studio, outcome insurance, external certification authority). The twelve baseline lenses cover how Nortropic works and what it must stay true to, not which business it is in.

Terminology governance — naming a concept canonically is itself a decision class reserved to the owner, and an assistant-coined containment hierarchy must be falsified against the corpus before it is treated as settled. Neither the coining nor the retirement of a canonical term fits any of the twelve lenses; the refutation half of the same arc does, and is lensed truth-trust.

External market structure, named competitors/incumbents, market sizing and go-to-market positioning as falsifiable strategic input. None of the twelve lenses covers competition, market timing or where the company sells; these items carry the named entities and dated figures that the surviving strategic conclusions were drawn from.
Go-to-market: who buys, at what price, and how a market position is defended. The twelve lenses describe how Nortropic works internally, not which customers it sells to or how it competes for them.
Geography and capital structure: where the company is built, financed and sold from. No lens covers the location of R&D, capital and category, or the sequence in which a company takes outside money.

External market and regional demand evidence, and the market-shaped company forms it suggests (regional capacity shortage, public sector, ownership rather than subscription). The lenses look inward at Nortropic's own operation; these items are about the world outside it.
Commercial strategy — what business Nortropic is in, for whom, at what price, and what it refuses to become

cross_source.claim: Two incompatible build orders run through the corpus and neither is retracted. CONV-030 holds both inside one turn set: its prose keeps Order A and says the build order is not to be changed, while its own diagrams in the same messages run Order B, and the plan the owner assents to at m18 states Order B. The choice is consequential in the corpus's own terms: under A the Kernel is proven by real customer web work and Recompile runs after real outcomes; under B Recompile runs on brainstorm corpus before any customer work exists, which CONV-030 m5 itself warns against. Recency selects B; owner voice selects A.

Both blind reviewers recorded the two orderings as separate uncontested facts, so the collision is a compile-layer observation, not a source-layer one.

Refusing peer interrupt-messaging (CONV-001 m29, and independently again in CONV-002 m3 where it is reframed as a falsification canary) generated the substitute: a worker presence registry plus typed durable task-bound auditable events, the Organizational Nervous System. Refusing an agent-owned release command (CONV-011 m4) was generalised two messages later into a rule against name-driven reintroduction - do not create an artefact because the old plan used its name.
cross_source.scope: organization / rejections as rule-bearing objects
cross_source.uncertainty: All three rejections and all three substitutes are assistant-voiced; no owner turn rules on any of them, and CONV-002 contains no owner turn at all, so its instance cannot carry owner weight even in principle. That the three share one shape is a compile-layer reading.
cross_source.resolved: The corpus settles the pattern - each rejection names the substitute or rule that replaces it, so losing the rejection loses an architectural commitment that exists only as its negative image. It settles no authority: the pattern is entirely assistant-authored. RND-240, RND-211 and RND-292 now carry the three primary rejections; the name-driven-reintroduction rule and CONV-002's independent second refusal remain unrepresented.

cross_source.claim: Three of the corpus's deferrals are not exclusions but standing conditions on today's design, and the condition is the load-bearing half. Weight-level model training is deferred while the data plane is prepared now, on the ground that skills, context and tools are easier to change and verify than baked-in weights, with the standing obligation that traces be designed so they can later become training data (CONV-001 m14) - restated independently at CONV-019 m12 as explicitly later, not excluded, with retrieval, durable memory and gated self-improvement first. Vector and graph databases are refused as a starting point: files plus Git plus deterministic indexes go further than expected, and SQLite, vector or graph indexes may later be generated as caches, never as source of truth (CONV-010 m10, CONV-005 m55, CONV-013 m187, CONV-001 m96). Multi-tenancy and the V0 exclusion list are deferred under 'Future-compatible is not future-built'.
cross_source.scope: continuity-operate-forever / deferrals with re-entry conditions
cross_source.uncertainty: Every statement in all three is assistant-voiced; the owner's own position on model training, on storage technology and on multi-tenancy is never recorded. The third rule's full form at CONV-028 m17 - do not prebuild a generic multi-tenant platform, but do not knowingly choose primitives that make future customer isolation impossible when an equally simple boundary exists - is the only one of the three that constrains a choice being made today rather than a choice being postponed.
cross_source.resolved: The corpus settles all three re-entry conditions in words and none of them as an owner decision. Read across sources these are resolved not-buildings with stated conditions, not open technology questions: a smaller and more actionable position than an open-question framing, and one already consistent with the corpus's no-second-source-of-truth law. What remains open is who may declare a condition met.

cross_source.claim: Not-building in this corpus has three authority classes, not two, and the third - an executing agent refusing on its own account - is materially different from both owner rejection and assistant recommendation. Claude Code declined to run an instructed chain on three combined grounds: the banked pre-reboot checkpoint could not be mechanically confirmed, so for those premises the handoff message was its own only authority; the chain terminated in unsupervised self-launch; and it was being asked to certify the confinement boundary as the precondition for expanding its own autonomy. It separately declared a standing platform boundary - that it would not itself drive guarded publication, contract publication, supervisor resume or first autonomous launch - framed as its own limit rather than an interpretation of Nortropic authority. The same class recurs as a build refusal in CONV-009 and as design-level refusals in CONV-016.
cross_source.scope: assurance-red-team / who may decline, and on whose authority
cross_source.uncertainty: The same agent withdrew its 'unverifiable' verdict one turn later after mechanical inspection, so the first ground was retracted while the other two were not. Whether the CONV-009 and CONV-016 instances are the same class or merely adjacent (a build refusal and design-level rejections) is a compile-layer grouping.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - the corpus settles that the class exists and recurs across three sources, and never states it as a rule. Whether an agent's own refusal binds the next agent, and whether the third ground - do not certify the boundary whose certification expands your own autonomy - is a reusable safety rule or a one-off incident, is nowhere decided. RND-287 now carries the handoff-authority requirement the refusal produced, not the refusal as an authority class.

cross_source.claim: Every time the owner invokes Lovable in his own words he means speed, and the desirability construct built on the word is a single assistant turn. CONV-018 m1 cites an earlier Lovable conversation as his reference point for how fast it is to build there. CONV-014 m4 uses Lovable only as an example of low feedback-loop latency. CONV-028 m33 invokes it again for growth speed, tied to middle-out. Between them, CONV-028 m29's single ambition word - an innovative startup should have lovable successes - is converted by the assistant into a Lovability / Product Experience lens with Time to Magic, a stuckness taxonomy, bypass pressure and a desirability dimension. That lens is one of the twelve through which the compile reports coverage, and one of the two the corpus itself calls thin, so an assistant extension of one word is doing instrument work.
cross_source.scope: lovability-product-experience / what the owner's referent actually is
cross_source.uncertainty: CONV-018 m1's reference is to a Lovable conversation that is not in the bound set, so the owner's fullest statement of what he means is unreadable here. The register holds both readings honestly but in separate items with disjoint provenance; nothing states that the owner's referent is the same one in all three of his turns.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - the corpus settles the owner's referent (speed: build-loop latency and growth speed, in each of his three own turns) and does not settle that product desirability is owner-wanted. The extension is legitimate and assistant-originated, and the two readings produce different work: craft, taste and delight against feedback-loop latency.

cross_source.claim: 'Recompile' names three different objects across four conversations, and the only sense with owner constraints attached carries two constraints that oppose each other. The senses: Improvements Recompile, the Kernel's first mission after Bootstrap, an internal one-off corpus rebaseline (CONV-001 m64, CONV-028 m12); Function Recompile, a continuous runtime learning stage beside Function Intake and Function Compiler (CONV-029 m10); and Nortropic Organization Recompile, a saleable customer transformation product bridging Digital Department to Organization OS (CONV-030 m5). On sense (1) the owner both pushes back on scale at CONV-028 m11 (surely this is not a year of architecture work) and sets a maximal input bar at m13 (by the time Recompile is reached there must be a consolidated picture with every stone turned inside out). The two are in tension by construction: maximal input completeness against minimal output and duration.
cross_source.scope: rnd-intake / Recompile - referent and scope
cross_source.uncertainty: The second owner constraint is phrased as a question-pushback rather than a ruling, and the register already notes that. The three senses are named in three different sources and no source acknowledges the polysemy, so the conflation hazard is a compile-layer observation.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - nothing disambiguates the three senses, so sense (1)'s hard owner constraints can be inherited by a runtime learning loop or a customer product, or a customer product's scope read as licence for the internal rebaseline. Nor are the two owner constraints reconciled by the owner: the assistant's resolution across the following twenty messages (Recompile has failed if it produces months of architecture before the next real operating loop; it must make the system smaller, not larger; and it declines at m32 to open a seventh conceptual campaign) is assistant-authored and unratified. Recorded as one coherent position, 'every stone turned inside out' becomes licence for the unbounded pre-Recompile campaign the same conversation refused.

cross_source.claim: The narrowness of the owner-authority surface is a measurable corpus-wide property, not a set of incidents, and the OWNER_DECISION register is distributed inversely to it. Across the thirty sources there are 581 owner turns holding 668,778 characters against 5,420,273 assistant characters; at least 160 of those turns carry pasted machine output and hold 557,402 of the owner-turn characters (83.3%), giving an upper bound of 1.91% owner-composed prose in 6.09 million characters. Where a per-turn census was run rather than inferred - all 70 owner turns of CONV-008 - the figure is 2.0%. Yet the register is densest exactly where owner voice is thinnest: CONV-015 supplies 16 and CONV-013 13 of the 76 owner decisions (38%) while 67% and 95% of their owner-turn characters sit in paste-carrying turns, and CONV-016, CONV-030 and CONV-011 produce no owner-voice architectural content decision at all.
cross_source.scope: truth-trust / the owner-authority surface as a measured property
cross_source.uncertainty: The 1.91% is an upper bound computed by classifying a turn as owner prose unless a blind reviewer happened to extract a finding from paste inside it, so the true figure is lower. Only CONV-008 was censused turn by turn; the other per-source figures are inferred from paste detection. The register counts are over the r38 202-item register, before the remediation pass.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - the corpus settles the numbers and nothing about how they should be weighted. No source states a rule for reading a register whose density tracks owner-LABELLED turns rather than owner-AUTHORED text, so the densest evidence continues to look like the strongest, and it is densest in the two threads where the corpus itself records that the assistant took decisions under owner labels. The negative per-source fact is the actionable one: CONV-016 is an execution log, not a design record, and its content is assistant design the owner did not contradict.

cross_source.claim: Handoff-prompt paste makes an assistant turn from one conversation appear as an owner turn in another, and every quality gate in this review chain is blind to it by construction. CONV-012 m1 is a 7,566-character owner-labelled turn carrying the whole Nortropic Aquarium specification; all 45 of its paragraph blocks of 60 or more characters are verbatim present in CONV-005 m79, a ChatGPT turn that ends by instructing the owner to paste it, and the only owner-composed content is one 41-character line naming the chat. Both blind slots filed it as owner voice, 62 findings between them. The reconcile layer's strongest attestations - zero false owner attributions, 214/214 anchors exact substrings, none of it is imported - all pass on it, because the text was written by the same assistant in a sibling conversation. The same paragraph is then counted twice as two conversations' independent instantiations.
cross_source.scope: truth-trust / cross-source paste and what the review method can guarantee
cross_source.uncertainty: The 45/45 block identity was re-verified directly against the two raw turns for this pass. How often the pattern recurs is not measured: handoff-prompt paste is the corpus's standard way of continuing a track in a new chat, instructed by the assistant itself, so the frequency is plausibly higher than the one confirmed instance but is not counted here.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - the corpus settles that recurrence across these conversations is shared prior context rather than independent corroboration, and does not settle the sharper form of that rule: shared prior context can be literal, and when it is, an owner turn in one conversation is an assistant turn from another. No check in the chain compares owner turns against other sources' assistant turns - the one test that catches it is outside the blind protocol by construction and outside the reconcile protocol by instruction - and the corpus's own tooling could run it and does not. The register catches the instance once, in one uncertainty field, and never as a method limit.

cross_source.claim: A distinct class of owner authority recurs across the corpus and has no name: the interface-submission decision, in which the owner-labelled turn contains no owner words at all - only a pasted machine interface whose question, options and preferred answer the machine authored - and the owner's act is visible solely as a checkbox strip advancing between turns. In CONV-001 m85-92 the sweep tool printed four review-group questions with numbered options, marking its own preferred option '(Recommended)'; the assistant then named the option to pick ('Välj 1', 'Skriv detta:'); and the owner turns are the strip '☒ Reversals ☐ Assist-only ☐ Relationer ☐ Bilagor ✔ Submit →' followed by the next machine-authored question. CONV-005 m58 has the same shape, and its '❯ 1. SUPERSEDE (Recommended)' is the act that retired the kommun idea package into Organization OS.
cross_source.scope: truth-trust / how machine interfaces produce owner-attributed decisions
cross_source.uncertainty: The register is honest instance by instance - it records that the wording is assistant-authored and the owner act is a selection - and two of the four CONV-001 items quote the machine's own option text as the owner quote. What is uncertain is durability, not fact: the corpus never says whether a selection the owner did not resist is a constraint or a machine default.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - the corpus produces two durable state changes this way (four sweep review policies written into the idea corpus, and the supersession of the kommun idea package) and never names the class or rules on what such a selection is worth. The design implication is stated nowhere: an owner-approval surface that pre-marks its own recommendation and then records the resulting keystroke as owner authority manufactures owner provenance rather than capturing it - and the system being designed contains exactly such a surface.

cross_source.claim: The corpus's central product name and its governing organisational frame have no owner-composed occurrence, and the frame assigns the owner his own constitutional position. A per-message role census finds 'Organization OS' in twelve sources with every occurrence inside assistant turns except five in owner-labelled turns, and all five are machine text the owner relayed: a pasted Intake CLI menu, a pasted Claude Code report that refers to him in the third person, a sweep interface, the CONV-012 handoff paste, and CONV-008 m179 where he quotes back the assistant's own roadmap diagram from CONV-005 m62. The frame itself is CONV-021: the owner's whole contribution is one 159-character question, and the assistant's single 5,382-character reply builds the municipal architecture including a Kommun-to-Nortropic mapping whose first row assigns 'Kommunfullmäktige' to 'Owner / konstitution'. The owner never states that mapping.
cross_source.scope: organization / authorship of the central vocabulary and of the owner's own role
cross_source.uncertainty: CONV-008 m179 is the one of the five occurrences the CONV-008 census classifies as owner prose; it is a relay of an assistant diagram, prefaced 'Tidigare pratade vi om den här planeringen', so its status is a judgement rather than a mechanical fact. The register already types the CONCEPT's authorship correctly; the claim here is about the NAME and the mapping row, which no item addresses.
cross_source.resolved: The corpus settles that the concept was elaborated by the assistant on owner-supplied metaphors and does not settle that the name or the constitutional mapping is owner intent. UNRESOLVED - the owner's later fluent self-descriptions inside the vocabulary ('jag blir som en enhetschef över min digitala AI fabrik', 'Kommundirektören störs bara när det verkligen behövs') show the frame was acceptable, not that it was chosen, and an assistant sentence remains the corpus's only statement of where the owner's constitutional authority sits - with a Managing Director design being built on top of it.

cross_source.claim: The compile states a requirement it does not apply to itself. RND-104 requires that owner-authority provenance be role-aware and machine-resolvable - an OWNER_DECISION needs an owner message, an assistant message can never alone satisfy owner-backed authority, weak approval stays visibly weak - and its own uncertainty adds that this compile is subject to it. In the schema it is not: all 76 items typed OWNER_DECISION carry the identical authority_class 'owner', authority_class is a deterministic function of kind and so carries no independent information, and no typed field distinguishes an owner-worded decision from one whose entire content the assistant authored and the owner assented to. The distinction survives only in prose - 57 of 76 carry a caveat, 19 do not, and the one machine-readable tag that could carry it appears on 13.
cross_source.scope: truth-trust / machine-resolvable owner provenance in the artifact itself
cross_source.uncertainty: The field audit is over the r38 202-item register. The item-level attribution prose is genuinely good and specific; the defect is in the interface, not the narrative, so the two assessments are both true and the tension between them is the finding. Whether a consuming system would in fact filter on kind and authority_class rather than read the prose is an assumption, though it is the assumption RND-104 itself makes.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - the corpus settles the requirement, in the owner-backed form 'En assistant-message får aldrig ensam uppfylla ett krav på owner-backed', and never states what typed field would carry the distinction. Measured on the quoted evidence, 32 of the 76 rest on 60 characters or less of owner text and 13 on a bare assent token ('gör det', 'Ge mig prompten', 'Ja, detta gillar jag.', 'Ja, bevaka och jag håller med om den inledande planen'), so a consumer filtering on the only machine-resolvable fields recovers 76 undifferentiated owner decisions - the exact failure RND-104 was written to prevent after it had already occurred once in Intake v2.1.
